cases.name: launch
cases.subject: Cold launch and re-entry
cases.acceptance: Native app opens without blank/frozen screen; record launch time without inventing an accepted threshold.

cases.name: catalog
cases.subject: Three manufacturing specialties
cases.acceptance: Mechanical/electrical/surface open with correct counts and preserve independent progress.

cases.name: reader
cases.subject: Core lesson plus all source guides
cases.acceptance: Japanese stays canonical; translation toggle uses selected locale; completion/reopen persists.

cases.name: diagrams
cases.subject: All22actualtechnicalfigures
cases.acceptance: Images have real decoded bytes; pinch/zoom/pan/close work; essential labels readable in portrait/landscape.

cases.name: weekly
cases.subject: Weekly check and new8question supplement
cases.acceptance: No answer/reason before submit; answer and question position survive leaving/reopening; correct scoring after submit.

cases.name: mocks
cases.subject: Thirtyoriginalandthreecuratedforms
cases.acceptance: Distinct IDs/attempts; theory/practical clocks and independent thresholds; no premature results.

cases.name: background
cases.subject: Native background/foreground
cases.acceptance: Background during timed exam then restore; elapsed real time and expiry retain original deadline.

cases.name: restart
cases.subject: Explicit restart and cancellation
cases.acceptance: Cancelling restart preserves prior attempt; confirmed restart binds current revision.

cases.name: failure
cases.subject: Storage failure and retry where injectable
cases.acceptance: Record actual failure injection method; do not call ordinary navigation a storage-failure test.

cases.name: hardwareback
cases.subject: Platform navigation
cases.acceptance: Android hardware Back and iOS interactive/native navigation preserve expected screens and saved state.

cases.name: glyphs
cases.subject: All13UIlocales
cases.acceptance: Inspect rendered glyphs and long text on physical hardware; DOM text presence is not glyph certification.

cases.name: offline
cases.subject: Bundled offline assets/content
cases.acceptance: After first native bundle/install, verify intended offline content; record which content is available, no unsupported blanket offline claim.

evidenceRequiredPerDevice: native app build ID and source commit
actual screen recordings/screenshots for tested cases
test operator identity and explicit outcome
privacy: Serial/UDID and raw log personal data should stay private; public reports may use a stable device alias and hashes of privately retained evidence.
interpretation: This matrix is a plan only; generating it does not execute or pass a device test.
